reviews.title: OpenDesign
reviews.recommendation: Try the desktop app, but treat the repository harvest as equally important: compare its contracts against the current DigitalStudioz skill-pack conventions.

reviews.title: ComfyUI-Ref2VA-VSA
reviews.recommendation: Run the side-install benchmark first. Adopt only if it stays under 16GB VRAM and character hold scores at least 4/5.

reviews.title: Grit & Chaos — Divi 5 website built with Claude (skill)
reviews.recommendation: Harvest complete. Next step is the pending merge of the lane-1 pack into Website-Templates .cursor/skills — Jon runs at Vader via Cursor on his go.

reviews.title: Aning — code-wordpress (Codex + Elementor workflow)
reviews.recommendation: Cherry-pick the skill shapes and blueprint packaging into the skill pack. Compare its conventions against the current pack before adopting.

reviews.title: Noizefield Audio Plugin Coder
reviews.recommendation: Evaluate against the VST3 stack lock when plugin work starts. Pair with the pluginval QA gate before any scaffold decision.

reviews.title: MiniMax H3 video model
reviews.recommendation: Keep testing. Do not expand scope beyond fun testing until Jon reviews the license grant email (see linked to-do).

reviews.title: Ultimate Vocal Remover GUI
reviews.recommendation: Study the UX and model roster as the benchmark. Do not adopt its weights blindly — commercial-safe picks stay the locked MIT models.

reviews.title: RoboSync — modern robocopy GUI
reviews.recommendation: Trial on Vader first (see the linked to-do). Build Vader Desk only if the existing tools miss the stacked-jobs + preset workflow.

reviews.title: StemKit
reviews.recommendation: Keep parked as the architecture reference. Revisit only when the Stem Splitter satellite gets a scoped go from Jon.

reviews.title: Ship an iOS app with Codex
reviews.recommendation: Do not pursue the iOS workflow now. Apply its evidence-tied DONE / JON OWES pattern to future Cursor briefs.

reviews.title: Pamplejuce — JUCE/VST3 starter template
reviews.recommendation: At scaffold time, start from Pamplejuce and run the pluginval ≥ 5 QA gate per the stack lock.

reviews.title: Osmantic ODS
reviews.recommendation: Keep it parked until the spare PC becomes an active homelab project, then use ODS as a comparison baseline rather than an automatic install.

reviews.title: Higgsfield official API
reviews.recommendation: Use it only as a cloud comparison point or a fallback after the local Ref2VA test. Do not fold it into the default pipeline.

reviews.title: Odin 2 + Dexed — open-source synth references
reviews.recommendation: Reference only. Revisit when instrument design starts.

reviews.title: OpenHiggsfield
reviews.recommendation: Do not install it. Revisit only when designing a unified local studio front end and borrow the model-catalog and reuse interactions.

reviews.title: 3D-engine MCP control — Blender / Unreal / Unity
reviews.recommendation: Stay parked until a real 3D/agent task appears. Re-read the safety rule before the first run.

reviews.title: FlutterFlow
reviews.recommendation: Stay parked until a real iOS project appears. Revisit cost math then; the research is done and filed.

reviews.title: MetaGPT
reviews.recommendation: Skip the framework. Keep only the SOP vocabulary if the website-build system later needs more formal stage contracts.

reviews.title: higgsfield-ai/higgsfield
reviews.recommendation: Leave it skipped. It should not enter the backlog unless model training becomes a real project lane.
